entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Don't add "unknown" to Blazor metrics #63350
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-noop #63347
  • Perf improvement: fortunes #63346
  • [Blazor] Support kebab-case file names for Razor components with auto-mapping to PascalCase class names #63343
  • Blazor wasm can not be deployed to Azure Blob Storage Website #63341
  • [NETSDKE2E]CoreFX symbols are missing for IL symbols on 17.14.13 Preview 1 + 10.0.100-rc.1.25418.116 (runtime-10.0.100-rc.1.25418.116). #63344

Closed

  • ValidationProblemDetails errors ignored by problem details writer #63345
  • MapStaticAssets not behaving like UseStaticFiles middleware resulting in entire pipeline being run for every static asset - massively slow. #59315
  • Retry `E2ETest.ServerExecutionTests.CircuitTests.ComponentLifecycleMethodThrowsExceptionTerminatesTheCircuit` #57551
    10.0-rc2
  • [Blazor] PersistentState design question #63329
  • Quarantine FormWithParentBindingContextTest.RadioButtonGetsResetAfterSubmittingEnhancedForm #61144
    10.0-rc2
  • Quarantine SubmitButtonFormactionAttributeOverridesEnhancedFormAction #60067
    10.0-rc2
  • Build *sporadically* fails with Microsoft.NET.Sdk.StaticWebAssets.Compression.targets: error : IOException: The process cannot access the file (..) because it is being used by another process #62565
